items.title: AWS Continuum now supports credential testing and accessible domain suggestions
items.blurb: AWS Continuum for penetration testing is a frontier agent that proactively secures applications throughout the development lifecycle by offering on-demand, customized penetration testing with real exploitability testing.

items.title: Amazon ECS Express Mode now supports AWS Graviton (ARM64) workloads
items.blurb: Amazon Elastic Container Service Express Mode now supports specifying ARM64 as the CPU architecture for your service, making it easy to deploy ARM-based container images on AWS Graviton-powered compute and benefit from up to 40% better…

items.title: AWS Resilience Hub adds three new capabilities
items.blurb: The next generation of AWS Resilience Hub is a central location in the AWS that helps platform engineering and site reliability teams assess and strengthen the resilience of their workloads running on AWS.

items.title: AWS RTB Fabric now supports configurable Availability Zone affinity
items.blurb: AWS RTB Fabric now supports configurable Availability Zone (AZ) affinity for responder gateways.

items.title: Kimi K3 by Moonshot AI is now generally available on Amazon Bedrock
items.blurb: Amazon Bedrock continues to expand its open weight model portfolio with the same security and governance that customers rely on.

items.title: Amazon SNS now supports message payloads up to 1 MiB
items.blurb: Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) now supports message payloads up to 1 MiB, a 4x increase from the previous 256 KiB limit, so you can publish larger messages to your SNS topics.

items.title: SolidStart 2: Replaces Vinxi with a Vite 8 and Enters Maintenance as Its Role Winds Down
items.blurb: SolidStart, a full-stack meta-framework based on SolidJS, has transitioned to version 2.0, improving compatibility with Vite's Environment API.

items.title: MariaDB 13 Expands Oracle Compatibility and Improves Developer Experience and Observability
items.blurb: MariaDB Community Server 13.0 has reached General Availability (GA) and is now officially stable.

items.title: Release v0.29.0 · warp-tech/warpgate
items.blurb: Fully transparent SSH, HTTPS, Kubernetes, database and RDP/VNC bastion/PAM that doesn't need additional client-side software - Release v0.29.0 · warp-tech/warpgate
